body: Fresh privacy audit found one small seam now that you own privacy.scala: PseudonymizationTableEntry is a public case class and currently inherits a toString that exposes both source surface and pseudonym; interview.PseudonymEntry already redacts. Please add an override such as PseudonymizationTableEntry(<redacted>, caseInsensitive=...) plus a no-canary assertion in your integrated ContractSuite/PrivacySuite work, or briefly release privacy.scala if you prefer I patch it. This does not change identity/behavior semantics.
